notes: The fixed 624-option catalogue is unchanged. Help assertions credit only each command's --help option, never displayed flags or command execution.
Help commands receive no CLI behavior requirement mapping. Global help and informational mappings satisfy their complete existing obligations.
Default architecture comes from the independently prepared fixture. Supported architectures use static x86_64 compatibility metadata in native-first order, accepting whitespace-separated output.
Version checks product and release syntax, without requiring the target and fixture producer to have the same version.

behaviors.description: Request --help independently for all 44 frozen documented commands.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh isolated environment; no installed app or running service is needed.
behaviors.expected: Every call exits successfully with stdout usage naming that command, a described help option, and documented command-specific option or positional syntax; stderr is empty.
Successful exit, global usage, described help option, documented commands and informational options on stdout, empty stderr.

behaviors.description: Compare --default-arch with independently prepared native fixture metadata.
behaviors.preconditions: Native fixtures prepared for this execution host.
behaviors.expected: Successful exit with exactly the fixture architecture token on stdout and empty stderr.

behaviors.description: Compare --supported-arches with static native-first x86 compatibility metadata.
behaviors.preconditions: Native x86_64 fixture; other architectures report an unmet prerequisite.
behaviors.expected: Successful exit with exactly x86_64 then i386 as whitespace-separated tokens and empty stderr.
Successful exit, Flatpak product name and numeric release version on stdout, empty stderr.
